pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + an ender pearl. Starts waiting without an anchor.

With full stamina and an empty inventory slot, right-click to pin it and receive a Slime Teleporter. Linking spends all its stamina. Primary and shared owners may link it. The teleporter keeps the companion identity rather than a fixed coordinate.

Use the teleporter to reach a safe space beside the living pinned companion, including another dimension. The destination must have full stamina and spends it all on successful travel. There is no pearl consumption or teleport damage. Unsafe, missing, or unauthorized destinations fail without spending stamina.

A pinned Ender Slime keeps one destination chunk ticking, including across restarts. The default limit is eight pinned companions per primary owner. Follow releases the anchor; recovery and collapse release its chunk. A restored pinned companion anchors at its new release position.

Stamina recovers by 2% of its maximum each second while resting, so a complete recharge takes about 50 seconds. Increasing maximum stamina also increases recovery and does not shorten that full-charge time. Shared ownership and recovery retain the original owner identity. Release and revival also require a free anchor slot; the stored companion is kept when full.
